description: PPR06 - Centrale elettrica is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis2.regione.sardegna.it. PPR Settlement Structure, Infrastructure SystemSpecial elements identifying infrastructures for the production and distribution of electricity in the energy cycle (production plants, stations and substations of the electricity grid, power lines and wind power plants). These are building products that can have a strong impact on the landscape (e.g. support lattice of distribution cables). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PPR06 — Power plant" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include centrale elettrica, elettricità, piano paesaggistico regionale, assetto insediativo, opendata, ppr. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
